(rule!
  ;; Fill the tight bounding box of every blue (1) cell with cyan (8).
  ;; Painting the full rectangle replaces the blue cells and background gaps.
  (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells (find-color g 1))))
    (if bb
        (paint-cells g
                     (positions-in-rect
                      (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb))
                     8)
        g)))
